questions.q_en:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

BG - 38 - LQ

JO - 70 - TY
questions.solution_en:
BG - 36 - LQ

JO - 70 - TY

Here, the pattern is:

B+5= G; G+5= L; L+5= Q. Also, B+G+L+Q = 38.

J+5=O; O+5= T; T+5= Y. Also, J+O+T+Y = 70.

Option (a) MR - 60 - WB

M+5= R; R+5= W; W+5= B. Also, M+R+W+B = 56.

So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) CI - 42 - NS

C+6=I; I+5= N; N+5= S. Also, C+I+N+S = 45.

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c) FK - 54 - PU

F+5= K; K+5= P; P+5=U. Also, F+K+P+U = 54.

So, option (c) is correct.

Option (d) SX - 71 - YZ

S+5= X; X+1= Y; Y+1=Z. Also, S+X+Y+Z = 94.

So, option (d) is incorrect.

questions.q_en:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set:

(16, 12, 20)

(33, 41.66, 92)

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
questions.solution_en:
The middle number is equal to one third of sum of remaining two numbers.

Middle number = (1/3) * (first number + third number)

(1/3) * (16 + 20) = 36/3 = 12

Similarly,

(1/3) * (7 + 26) = 33/3 = 11

Hence the correct answer is '(7,11,26)'.
